Got questions?

Everything you need to know

Pricing, quality, refunds, security — all the answers in one place.

🔍

Will it look fake? Can my customers tell it's AI?

No. Tantu reproduces your fabric, print and colour pixel-true, with realistic drape and fit on a real-looking model. Sellers report passing Myntra and Amazon image QC on the first try with zero retouches. Drag the before/after slider above to judge for yourself.

Are AI-generated photos allowed on Myntra, Meesho and Amazon?

Marketplace image policies target misrepresentation, not how an image was rendered. The photo must show the product the buyer actually receives. Tantu reproduces your garment exactly, and our marketplace presets handle background, crop and resolution. Check your platform's current guideline before a large upload.

How is this different from hiring a photographer?

A traditional fashion shoot costs ₹15,000–₹50,000 per session and 1–2 weeks turnaround. Tantu starts at ₹9 per photo and delivers in minutes, with unlimited retakes and no studio booking.

How fast is a single shoot?

A full 12-pose HD catalogue completes in about 3 minutes end-to-end. Smaller pose sets finish proportionally faster.

What image quality and formats do I get?

Render at 1K, 2K and up to 4K HD in 6 aspect ratios — 1:1, 3:4, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9 and 3:2. Downloads are PNG/JPG, single-image or bulk ZIP.

Do credits expire? Are there subscriptions?

No expiry, no subscriptions, no monthly bills. Buy credits once, use them whenever you need.

What happens if a generation fails?

You are not charged. Failed poses automatically return the credits to your balance and you can retry only the failed pose.

Can I use the images commercially?

Yes. Every image generated under your plan is yours to use commercially — listings, ads, packaging, lookbooks, social. No additional licensing fee.

Do you support Indian ethnic wear?

Indian fashion is our core. Dedicated pipelines for kurti sets, sarees, lehengas, sherwanis and dupattas, plus heritage backgrounds like Udaipur, Jaipur and Varanasi, and 40+ regional Indian ethnicities.

Is my fabric design safe and private?

Yes. Uploads are private, stored securely and never used to train any model. You retain full ownership of your designs and generated images.

Can I refine a generation with feedback?

Yes. Type a natural-language prompt like "make sleeves looser" or "warmer lighting" on any result and Tantu regenerates that variant — same model identity, scene and pose.

Do I need design or photography skills?

No. The app guides you step-by-step: upload → pick model + style → choose pose set → generate. Sensible defaults work out-of-the-box. Power users can fine-tune every detail.

What is Tantu Studio?

Tantu Studio is our flagship multi-look campaign mode. Upload a collection of the same garment type (e.g. four saree colourways), set creative direction, and AI plans and shoots a unified editorial campaign — full collection covers, combo covers, and individual look shots with per-look models and poses. Sign up free with 50 credits to try regular single-garment photoshoots; Studio unlocks when you have 51+ credits.

What is Tantu?

Tantu is an AI fashion photography platform that turns a single garment, fabric or flat-lay photo into a complete on-model catalogue shoot — no studio booking, model casting or photographer required.

How does AI fashion photography work?

You upload one clear photo of the garment — a flat-lay, hanger shot or fabric swatch — then pick a model, scene and pose set. Tantu renders that exact garment on a photoreal model, reproducing the print, weave and embroidery from your reference image so the photo matches the product a buyer actually receives.

Who uses Tantu?

Tantu is built for Indian apparel sellers who need catalogue photography at volume: D2C fashion brands, boutique owners, saree and kurti wholesalers, Meesho and Myntra suppliers, and manufacturers going direct to consumers.

What can Tantu shoot?

Tantu handles sarees, kurtis and kurta sets, lehengas, salwar suits, menswear and sherwanis, western dresses, footwear and jewellery. Dedicated pipelines per garment type preserve drape, fall and fit, and Tantu Studio shoots an entire collection as one campaign with matching covers and per-look shots.

Still have questions?

Our team is one tap away. Tell us what you're shooting and we'll guide you to the right plan.
